entry.title: Insane POV from Red Bull Rampage 2026

media:group.media:title: Insane POV from Red Bull Rampage 2026
media:group.media:description:
See Red Bull Rampage 2026 through GoPro Athlete @RidewithRiddle's eyes with his raw POV run, shot on GoPro MAX2, from the drop-in to the finish corral 🤯
Jaxson Riddle (USA) is one of Rampage’s most distinctive MTB riders. His motocross-inspired style has been turning heads in Virgin, Utah since his first Rampage in 2021, where he won the Style Award. For Rampage 2026 he rode a clean run with his signature style and scored 85.87, which put him in second place when the competition ended early.
About Red Bull Rampage 2026 Red Bull Rampage is the world’s premier invitation-only freeride mountain bike competition. The 2026 men’s event was held on October 10 in southwest Utah, where riders build their own lines into the desert mountainside along with two helpers. This year's event marked 25 years of Rampage, with riders returning to the original 2001 venue. Strong winds forced organizers to stop the event, so no official winner was declared.

media:group.media:title: Racing America's Most Dangerous Mountain
media:group.media:description:
Strap in for a run up Pikes Peak with Valentin Simonet and his Renault Sport R.S. 01 at The Pikes Peak International Hill Climb. Pikes Peak, known as "America's Mountain," rises above Colorado Springs, Colorado. The event, nicknamed "The Race to the Clouds," has run since 1916 and is America's second oldest motorsport event.
The course is 12.42 miles (19.99km) with 156 turns, starting at mile 7 on Pikes Peak Highway and climbing 4,720ft (1,440m) to a finish at 14,115ft (4,302m), on grades averaging 7.2%. The start line sits at 9,390 feet, so drivers gain nearly 5,000 vertical feet in a single run. A drive that takes the average person one to three hours takes these drivers around ten minutes.
On June 21, 2026, Simonet became the first driver to take a Renault to the top of Pikes Peak. He finished third in the Pikes Peak Open class, second-best rookie and 13th overall out of 73 competitors, with a time of 9:59.9. That's a sub-10-minute run on one of the most demanding courses in motorsport.

media:group.media:title: 4K Coffee Break | Soaring Over Alaska
media:group.media:description:
Experience the breathtaking scale of Alaska in 4K. From towering mountain peaks and massive valley glaciers to coastal rainforests and rugged shorelines, this cinematic FPV drone film captures the wild beauty of America’s Last Frontier from above.
In the spring and fall of 2023, @joshuaturner traveled to Alaska with a few friends to capture surfing around Seward and Sitka. While the trip was originally focused on the water, he came home with hours of FPV drone footage showcasing the incredible landscapes they encountered along the way.
Alaska’s sheer scale is difficult to understand until you see it in person—and even then, it’s hard to capture. This film offers a glimpse of the vast mountains, glaciers, forests, and coastline that make Alaska unlike anywhere else.
